summary: Iteration 11 verified the keyboard-overlap fix (QuestionLayout migrated from RN KeyboardAvoidingView to KeyboardAwareScrollView + KeyboardStickyView from react-native-keyboard-controller; footer height measured via onLayout, bottomOffset=footerH+16). ALL 4 review-request items PASS on the public preview URL (mobile viewport 390x844). (1) WEB REGRESSION FULL ONBOARDING E2E: fresh boot -> splash -> welcome -> referral skip -> all 20 question screens (q1-q20) rendered and advanced; name input filled; location/age/sexuality/motivation/obstacles/contacts/work/past/dreamLocation skipped via Skip links; gender 'Female', kids 'No', relationship 'Single', work sentiment 'Love it', home 'Beachfront Villa' option cards all selected correctly; multiline q9 (goals) and q16 (selfDesc) filled; q20 partner multiline filled + 'No' -> 'Generate My Profile' -> GeneratingScreen rendered -> auto-advanced (~9s) to /subscription?from=onboarding auth gate. (2) FOCUSED-INPUT BEHAVIOR: tapped/focused into text fields on q3 (name), q9, q16, q20 (multiline) — Continue/Generate My Profile footer button remained fully visible in viewport on every screen (bounding box y=798, height within 844 viewport), no overlap, no disappearance, no layout jumps, no crashes. (3) CONSOLE: ZERO errors/warnings mentioning react-native-keyboard-controller, KeyboardAwareScrollView, KeyboardStickyView or KeyboardProvider across the whole session; only known-benign carryovers (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver JS fallback, expo-notifications web listener) plus one benign audio pageerror 'play() interrupted by pause()' from the ambient-audio fade-out timer (pre-existing, not keyboard related). (4) BACK-BUTTON MEMORY REGRESSION: splash -> welcome -> 'Log in' -> /login -> browser back -> resumed at Welcome (screen 2), did NOT restart at splash. iteration_7 behavior intact.

react_native_issues.issue: INCONSISTENCY (not a regression): screen 3 ReferralScreen (onboarding.tsx:488) and AddContactModal (onboarding.tsx:149-152) still use RN KeyboardAvoidingView while QuestionLayout now uses KeyboardAwareScrollView/KeyboardStickyView. Optional: migrate ReferralScreen (onboarding.tsx:488) and AddContactModal (onboarding.tsx:149) from RN KeyboardAvoidingView to KeyboardAwareScrollView/KeyboardStickyView for consistency and to pre-empt the same overlap bug on the referral code screen.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct per react-native-keyboard-controller docs: KeyboardProvider wraps root (_layout.tsx:57), QuestionLayout renders KeyboardAwareScrollView for content with bottomOffset=footerH+16 and KeyboardStickyView wrapping the footer; footerH measured via onLayout into state (onboarding.tsx:258,272-300). This is the recommended pattern and avoids the unreliable KAV padding/height behavior.

KeyboardAwareScrollView props are sound: keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' (taps on option cards/Skip don't get swallowed), showsVerticalScrollIndicator off, contentContainerStyle carries padding. No scrollEnabled conflicts.
onboarding.tsx still imports KeyboardAvoidingView from react-native (line 15) — still legitimately used by ReferralScreen and AddContactModal; not dead code, but see inconsistency note above.

QuestionLayout is React.memo'd; adding footerH state inside it is safe (memo only blocks parent-driven re-renders, internal state updates still fire) — verified: footer button visible and correctly offset at runtime on all 20 question screens.

rca_of_issue: REVIEWED BUG (fixed by E1, verified): on mobile the soft keyboard overlapped/hid the Continue footer on question screens (worst on multiline q9/q16 and final 'Generate My Profile'). Root cause as reported: RN KeyboardAvoidingView (padding iOS / height Android) wrapping ScrollView + fixed footer is unreliable on devices. Fix: KeyboardAwareScrollView (bottomOffset = measured footer height + 16) + KeyboardStickyView footer from react-native-keyboard-controller. Web verification confirms sound implementation and zero regressions (all 25 screens, all inputs/options/skips, focused-input footer visibility, clean console, back-memory intact); physical-device keyboard behavior pending user confirmation in Expo Go as planned.
